title: A 45,000-Pound Mistake Exposed Metric Holdouts
hook: A 45,000-Pound Fuel Need Exposed One Metric Mistake
closing: Shared units are boring until a mismatch puts lives or missions at risk.
question: Should everyone use metric?

segments.say: Only 5% of countries still resist the metric system, making nonmetric measurement the global exception.
The probe flew 169 kilometers below plan because two teams measured its thrust differently.
The plane needed 45,000 pounds of fuel, but a unit mix-up left it short in the air.
